capabilities.title: Resume working session
capabilities.description: Return durable McCluster session state — workspace, active and stale work, pending approvals, checkpointed workstreams, catalog version, system health and exact deploy commit — so a model can rehydrate after context loss. Read-only.

capabilities.title: Checkpoint a workstream
capabilities.description: Owner-attributed record of where a line of work stands (branch, head, pull request, next step) plus one optional append-only event (decision, done, verified, blocker, unblocked, note, open), written to the private context plane in one transaction. Idempotent on the operation key; refuses credentials and raw transcripts. Queues no job, changes no code, deploys nothing, sends nothing and approves no decision. MCP only: the write needs the actor that only the MCP path carries.

capabilities.title: Read workstream checkpoints
capabilities.description: Read the checkpointed workstreams, active first, with their recent decisions, verified results, open questions and uncleared blockers, plus the generated resume packet. Read-only.

capabilities.title: Dispatch an owner message
capabilities.description: McCluster's conversational front end. Classifies one owner message (deterministic routing table, then the small resident model with a confidence threshold), records the routing decision in the private context plane before anything runs, then answers, asks one clarifying question, runs an approval-free capability on Core, or files a pending owner approval for anything the catalog gates. Never sends outside messages, merges, deploys to production, spends or deletes. MCP only: it needs the owner actor that only the MCP path carries. Idempotent on message_id.

capabilities.title: Read a dispatch turn
capabilities.description: Read one dispatch turn with its live job, approval and resident answer, plus a one-line relay for the conversation. Read-only.

capabilities.title: Start an approved dispatch
capabilities.description: Start a dispatch turn that was held for approval, only after the owner approved its control approval, before it expires, and only with the exact request that was approved. The database claims the turn once; a second call starts nothing. Owner only.

capabilities.title: System health
capabilities.description: Read health from the canonical McCluster control-plane edge.

capabilities.title: Search media models
capabilities.description: Discover enabled generative-media implementations by provider or media capability.

capabilities.title: Recommend a media model
capabilities.description: Rank media implementations for task fit, controls, quality, speed, and price.

capabilities.title: Generate media with an explicit model
capabilities.description: Submit a tracked media-generation job through McCluster budget, cost, and lineage controls.

capabilities.title: Get media job
capabilities.description: Read a media job, provider result, costs, and asset lineage.

capabilities.title: Generate image
capabilities.description: Provider-independent tracked image generation through McCluster routing, budgets, and lineage.

capabilities.title: Generate video
capabilities.description: Provider-independent tracked video generation for PRIM3 shots, trailers, and sequences.

capabilities.title: Generate audio
capabilities.description: Provider-independent tracked voice, music, or sound-effect generation.

capabilities.title: Generate 3D model
capabilities.description: Generate reusable tracked 3D assets with GLB output without exposing provider-specific request syntax.

capabilities.title: Generate navigable world
capabilities.description: Queue a durable world-production workflow that generates concepts and GLB modules, pauses for owner review, then hands approved assets to isolated Godot implementation.

capabilities.title: Research the web
capabilities.description: Run bounded current public-web discovery with timestamped provenance and source URLs.

capabilities.title: Inspect repository
capabilities.description: Read repository state, recent commits, drift, and optional installed tests without modifying source.

capabilities.title: Build code
capabilities.description: Queue an isolated reviewed code change that may create a draft branch/PR but never auto-merges or deploys.

capabilities.title: Build game experience
capabilities.description: Queue the durable PRIM3 autonomous production loop with real media generation, owner review, isolated implementation, and playtest stages.

capabilities.title: Read city lore
capabilities.description: Read the versioned city manifest or bounded authored business, NPC, item, brand and portal records. Read-only release data; no private memory, inference or purchases.

capabilities.title: Deploy preview
capabilities.description: Publish an approved ref as a temporary static preview on McCluster-owned compute. Requires explicit self-hosted preview configuration.

capabilities.title: Home-base AI chat
capabilities.description: Run a bounded conversational inference on McCluster-owned compute without naming a model or provider. Images ride on messages[].images as base64 (no data: prefix) and route the turn to a vision implementation; when no live node can see, the call fails with AI_CHAT_NO_VISION_NODE instead of answering from a text model.

images.description: base64 JPEG/PNG/WebP, each <=200000 decoded bytes, <=600000 per request, sniffed from bytes; routes the turn to a vision implementation

capabilities.title: Drive the node browser
capabilities.description: Owner-only. Runs a bounded batch of browser actions in the compute node's own Chromium profile on allowlisted hosts and returns the page state, a screenshot and an action log. Only an owned node the owner installed with -Browser advertises it; absent until one is live; never exposed over MCP.

capabilities.title: Read compute task
capabilities.description: Read the durable state and result of one McCluster compute task.

capabilities.title: Plan an objective
capabilities.description: Queue a bounded dependency-aware plan of safe unattended analysis and inspection work.

capabilities.title: Read operational ontology schema
capabilities.description: Read McCluster object types, link types, and governed action types for one organization.

capabilities.title: Query operational ontology
capabilities.description: Read materialized operational objects with canonical source provenance.

capabilities.title: Traverse ontology links
capabilities.description: Traverse typed incoming and outgoing links around an operational object.

capabilities.title: Apply governed ontology action
capabilities.description: Apply a bounded owner-attributed ontology action with durable action-run and lineage evidence. V1 effects are internal annotations, tags, and compatible typed links.

capabilities.title: Read ingestion connectors
capabilities.description: Read connector registry, cursors, policies and health.

capabilities.title: Read ingested source records
capabilities.description: Read content-addressed source records with provenance and trace ids.

capabilities.title: Begin ingestion run
capabilities.description: Begin a governed initial, incremental, replay or manual connector run.

capabilities.title: Write ingest record
capabilities.description: Write one content-addressed source record through the governed ingestion contract.

capabilities.title: Finish ingestion run
capabilities.description: Finalize connector cursor and observable success/partial/failure state.

capabilities.title: Read entity aliases
capabilities.description: Read candidate, resolved and rejected external identity aliases.

capabilities.title: Resolve entity alias
capabilities.description: Owner-attributed resolution of an external alias to an ontology object.

capabilities.title: Read fact claims
capabilities.description: Read provenance-backed facts, including conflicting values.

capabilities.title: Record fact claim
capabilities.description: Record a source-backed fact claim without silently overwriting competing evidence.

capabilities.title: Schedule AI meeting delegate
capabilities.description: Queue disclosed AI attendance before a future meeting and local transcript/debrief collection after it.

capabilities.title: Join meeting with AI delegate
capabilities.description: Immediately dispatch a transparently named McCluster AI attendee through the configured owned meeting engine.

capabilities.title: Remove AI meeting delegate
capabilities.description: Remove the McCluster AI attendee from an active meeting.

capabilities.title: Read AI meeting status
capabilities.description: Read live owned meeting-bot status.

capabilities.title: Read meeting transcript
capabilities.description: Read a speaker-attributed transcript from the owned meeting engine.

capabilities.title: Read delegate session
capabilities.description: Read durable meeting delegate session state from the canonical control plane.

capabilities.title: Read meeting chat
capabilities.description: Read live meeting chat after the deployed owned engine passes interactive-control validation.

capabilities.title: Send meeting chat
capabilities.description: Send a clearly attributable AI-delegate chat message after interactive-control validation.

capabilities.title: Speak in meeting
capabilities.description: Speak through the disclosed AI delegate only after the deployed owned engine passes live audio validation.

capabilities.title: Edit site copy
capabilities.description: Change the words on any page of matthew.mccluster.org without a deploy. Writes a content override row; the HTML in git is never rewritten, so every edit is reversible by deleting the row. Identify the target by its data-edit slot where one exists. Edits made here are tagged via='llm' and can be rolled back as a group with site_content_revert_via, separately from the owner's own edits.

slot.description: data-edit slot name, or a generated path

capabilities.title: Time lyrics to audio
capabilities.description: Produce line- and word-timed lyrics for one release with the owned lyric machine: Demucs vocal separation, faster-whisper recognition on the vocal, the creator's lyric sheet (or DistroKid TTML / LRC) mapped to what is sung, and wav2vec2 CTC word alignment. Output is the data/lyrics JSON every player reads, marked reviewed:false; lyrics the owner reviewed are never replaced.

capabilities.title: Separate a track into stems
capabilities.description: Split one track into every instrument with owned Demucs weights (htdemucs_6s: vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other; htdemucs: four stems) plus an instrumental mix. Stems are stored privately in mcc-gated-audio/stems/<track_key>/ with a manifest in public.music_stem_sets, and served to the owner only through short-lived signed URLs.
